scenario: An e-commerce operations agent processes a high-value customer return. It uses returns-reverse-logistics to authorise the return and score it for fraud risk, then uses financial-calculator to compute the net refund amount after restocking fees and deductions, and finally uses reporting to generate a refund disbursement summary for the payments team.
info_flow: returns-reverse-logistics adjudicates the return request and produces an RMA record with fraud score and fraud_review_status → financial-calculator computes the net refund amount from the RMA record fields → reporting produces a disbursement-ready summary for the payments team.
